embed.name: Pickday date picker
embed.help: Shows the delivery and pickup date picker in your cart and cart drawer. Settings are in the Pickday app.

cart.name: Pickday date picker
cart.help: Choose where the date picker sits on the cart page. Without this block it is placed above the checkout button.

product.name: Pickday delivery estimate
product.help: Shows the earliest delivery or pickup date for this product. Settings are in the Pickday app.
product.product: Product (leave empty to use the page's product)
product.formIdInfo: Only needed if a date picker on the product page doesn't save the date. Leave empty to detect it.
